top_signals.title: Oil Inventories in Western Nations Exhausted, Vitol CEO Warns of Tight Market
top_signals.summary: Oil inventories in western countries have been exhausted as a result of the Iran war, the boss of the world’s largest independent oil trader said, warning that fuel markets are likely to remain tight going into winter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Ukraine’s largest grocery store chain, ATB, confirmed that it was hit by a cyberattack after hackers posted an extortion demand on its website.

top_signals.title: Treasury withdraws crypto mixing rule, citing concerns over ‘chilling effect on legitimate activity’
top_signals.summary: FinCEN is withdrawing a proposal that would've designated crypto mixing a "primary money laundering concern" under the PATRIOT Act.
